compilerHelpers.name: BaseTransition
compilerHelpers.reason: Emitted only for a user-written <BaseTransition> tag (compiler-core tag map). The profile rejects that tag (U23 promises Transition only), so generated code must not import it.

compilerHelpers.name: KeepAlive
compilerHelpers.reason: Emitted only for a user-written <KeepAlive> tag. Public component (U21, P): user code may use it directly, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: Suspense
compilerHelpers.reason: Emitted only for a user-written <Suspense> tag. Suspense is E (U25) and rejected by the production profile, so generated code must not import it.

compilerHelpers.name: Teleport

compilerHelpers.name: Transition

compilerHelpers.name: TransitionGroup

compilerHelpers.name: capitalize

compilerHelpers.name: defineComponent
compilerHelpers.reason: Public API (A10, P): supported for user code. Emitted as the default export of script setup, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: isRef
compilerHelpers.reason: Public reactivity helper (V07, P): supported for user code. The compiler also emits it, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: mergeProps
compilerHelpers.reason: Public API (U13, P): supported for user code. Emitted for merged bindings in compiled templates, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: popScopeId

compilerHelpers.name: resolveFilter
compilerHelpers.reason: Emitted only for the removed | filter syntax (compiler-core wrapFilter, COMPILER_FILTERS). The profile rejects filter syntax (no filter API in design.md), so generated code never imports it.

compilerHelpers.name: unref
compilerHelpers.reason: Public reactivity helper (V07, P): supported for user code. The compiler also emits it for setup refs, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: useCssVars
compilerHelpers.reason: Public CSS contract (design 9.2, P): supported for user code. Emitted for v-bind() in <style>, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: useModel
compilerHelpers.reason: Public API (V26, P): supported for user code. Emitted by defineModel, so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: useSlots
compilerHelpers.reason: Public API (V25, P): supported for user code. Emitted when script setup calls defineSlots(), so no internal flag.

compilerHelpers.name: withAsyncContext
compilerHelpers.reason: Emitted for top-level await in script setup. Top-level await is E (S14) and rejected by the production profile, so generated code must not import it.

exports.name: cloneVNode
exports.note: Adapted: runtime-core cloneVNode over native VNodes (extraProps merged with the mergeProps rules; mergeRef and cloneTransition honoured). A non-VNode argument is a TypeError, where Vue reads the fields of any object. Readable fields as in h.

exports.name: compatUtils
exports.note: Compat-build utility. design.md makes no promise for the compat build, so it is unsupported by default.

exports.name: compile
exports.note: Runtime template compiler. A08 and design.md: no runtime template compiler; compile-time configuration only.

exports.name: devtools
exports.note: Devtools hook object (plumbing). Devtools support is a build-time profile control (A17), not this export.

exports.name: effect
exports.note: Public (P): effect(fn, options) of @vue/reactivity 3.5.43, production build. fn runs once before effect returns. options.scheduler and options.onStop are read; lazy is ignored, so effect(fn, { lazy: true }) also runs fn. A runner passed in is replaced by its function. Other option keys are not copied onto the runner's effect (Vue copies them with Object.assign).

exports.name: getCurrentInstance
exports.note: Adapted: returns an opaque handle of the current component instance, or null outside setup and render. The handle has a null prototype and no readable properties (proxy, props, attrs, slots, emit, uid, type, vnode, appContext and subTree are not reachable), so every property read is undefined. Supported: identity (one handle per instance) and null checks. Use defineProps, defineEmits, useAttrs and useSlots for those values.

exports.name: getCurrentWatcher
exports.note: Public (P): returns the watcher whose callback or watchEffect getter is running, otherwise undefined. The source function of watch(source, cb) is not wrapped, so it sees undefined.

exports.name: getTransitionRawChildren
exports.note: Internal transition helper.

exports.name: h
exports.note: Adapted: runtime-core h argument rules (plain-object props, one VNode child, variadic children) over native VNodes. Readable VNode properties: type, props, key, ref, children, shapeFlag, patchFlag, dynamicChildren, dynamicProps, appContext, ce, scopeId, slotScopeIds, dirs, transition, component, memo, cacheIndex, ctx, placeholder. Not readable: el, anchor, suspense, target, targetAnchor, targetStart, staticCount, ssContent, ssFallback, __v_isVNode.

exports.name: handleError
exports.note: Internal error dispatch helper; A06 errorHandler is the promised hook.

exports.name: initDirectivesForSSR
exports.note: Internal SSR directive helper.

exports.name: isRuntimeOnly
exports.note: Build-profile introspection; not promised.

exports.name: isVNode
exports.note: Adapted: true for a native VNode and for an object whose __v_isVNode property is true, as in runtime-core. The __v_isVNode property of a VNode is not readable (see h).

exports.name: mergeProps
exports.note: Public (P): runtime-core mergeProps (class and style normalized, listeners merged into arrays, later keys win). The compiler also emits it for merged bindings; see compilerHelperExclusions.

exports.name: proxyRefs
exports.note: Public (P): proxyRefs(objectWithRefs) of @vue/reactivity 3.5.43. Reactive objects are returned unchanged. Other objects get a proxy: reads unwrap top-level ref values, writes to a ref key set its value, and nested refs are not unwrapped.

exports.name: queuePostFlushCb
exports.note: Internal scheduler queue; nextTick (V17) is the promised surface.

exports.name: registerRuntimeCompiler
exports.note: Runtime template compiler registration. A08 and design.md: no runtime template compiler.

exports.name: resolveFilter
exports.note: Deprecated Vue 2 filter helper. Emitted only for the removed | filter syntax; the profile rejects filter syntax, so this name is not compilerInternal.

exports.name: resolveTransitionHooks
exports.note: Internal transition helper.

exports.name: setDevtoolsHook
exports.note: Devtools hook installer (plumbing). Devtools support is a build-time profile control (A17), not this export.

exports.name: setTransitionHooks
exports.note: Internal transition helper.

exports.name: ssrUtils
exports.note: Internal SSR utilities.

exports.name: stop
exports.note: Public (P): stop(runner) stops runner.effect. Its dependencies are dropped and onStop runs once; later calls of the runner run fn untracked. Stopping a stopped effect does nothing.

exports.name: useCssModule
exports.note: CSS contract, design 9.2 (SFC scoping: CSS modules class maps). @vue/compiler-sfc 3.5.43 has no reference to useCssModule, so it is not compilerInternal.

exports.name: useCssVars
exports.note: CSS contract, design 9.2 (SFC scoping: useCssVars / CSS v-bind expressions). useCssVars is emitted by the SFC compiler for v-bind() in <style>.

exports.name: useTransitionState
exports.note: Internal transition state helper.

exports.name: warn
exports.note: Internal warning emitter; the A06 warnHandler is the promised hook.
